specification.problem: Given an involution f in S_{2^n} (f(f(x))=x) as a permutation table on n lines, build a palindromic reversible circuit G=g1...gk...g1 (gate list equal to its reverse) over NOT/CNOT/Toffoli that computes f on the data lines, or, when not possible, an alternative palindromic representation using one extra ancilla line or controlled-V/V-dagger gates.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Tiny instances n=2,3 (up to 4 qubits including one ancilla). Covers: involution cycle decomposition, palindrome-as-involution property, parity obstruction check, conjugation form h c h^{-1}, and the verification readout. Outside scope: the paper's exact characterization theorem of which involutions are palindromic, the general ancilla construction proof, and the V/V-dagger construction details and their optimality.

symbols.domain: gate library NCT on the lines

symbols.meaning: palindromic circuit g_1...g_k...g_1, or g_1...g_k c g_k...g_1 with a central self-inverse gate c
conjugator circuit and self-inverse middle block
parity of the permutation f: (-1)^{number of transpositions}

equations.label: Involution
equations.description: Involution is a product of disjoint transpositions with remaining points fixed.
equations.abstract_quote: involutions in the symmetric group $S_{2^{n}}$ which are isomorphic to self-inverse reversible function on $n$ variables
equations.justification: Self-inverse functions correspond to involutions in the symmetric group, which have cycle type of 2-cycles and fixed points (standard group theory).
assumptions: f given as an explicit table

equations.label: Palindrome equals reverse
equations.latex: G=g_1 g_2\cdots g_k\cdots g_2 g_1,\quad G^{-1}=g_1\cdots g_k\cdots g_1=G
equations.description: A palindrome of self-inverse gates equals its reverse circuit and is hence an involution.
equations.abstract_quote: reversible circuits that are equal to their reverse circuit, which are called palindromic circuits
equations.justification: Reverse circuit of self-inverse gates is the mirrored gate list; palindrome means mirror equals itself.
assumptions: each gate is self-inverse (NOT, CNOT, Toffoli)
central gate, if present, is self-inverse

equations.label: Conjugation form
equations.description: Candidate palindrome via conjugating a self-inverse middle block c by h; if h is written as gates and h^{-1} is its mirror, G is palindromic when c is palindromic.
equations.justification: Sketch's proposed structure; the exact sufficiency/necessity conditions are not given in the abstract.
assumptions: c is itself a palindromic circuit or single self-inverse gate

equations.label: Parity obstruction
equations.description: On n>=4 lines NCT gates generate only even permutations, so an involution with an odd number of 2-cycles cannot be built without an extra line.
equations.justification: Known result on parity of reversible gates (Toffoli's even-permutation theorem); for n<=3 other obstructions may occur and are not specified here.

equations.label: Ancilla variant
equations.description: Circuit on n+1 lines acting as f on data and restoring ancilla to 0.
equations.justification: Sketch requirement; concrete construction not given.

registers.name: data
registers.role: holds x in {0,1}^n, bit i = qubit i (little-endian, x=sum x_i 2^i)

registers.name: anc
registers.role: optional ancilla, qubit index n, initialized |0> and returned to |0>

specification.initial_state: |x>_data|0>_anc for each basis input x in {0,...,2^n-1}

steps.description: Decompose f into transpositions and fixed points; compute t(f) and parity.
Search small NCT palindromes (gate sequences up to some length, optional central gate) for one whose permutation equals f, e.g. via conjugation of a simple middle gate.
If none exists, search palindromes on n+1 lines with ancilla returning to 0; otherwise a controlled-V/V-dagger palindrome.
Verify for all basis inputs: output equals f(x), ancilla 0, gate list equals reverse, and G applied twice is identity.

specification.measurement: Statevector simulation without measurement (or measure data bits only if counts requested); read output basis state; mind little-endian bit order.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Compare output index to f(x); check ancilla bit is 0; check gate list palindrome; check G·G=id.
assumptions: Chosen target: n=2 or 3 instances given as explicit permutation tables
Gate library NCT plus controlled-V/V-dagger for the quantum variant
Palindromic means identical gate sequence when reversed (V and V-dagger mirror placement needs care since V reversed is V-dagger)
missing_information: Exact necessary-and-sufficient characterization of palindromic-realizable involutions
Exact V/V-dagger palindrome construction (reverse of V is V†, so symmetric placement must be defined)
Cost metrics and gate set specifics
